purpose: Eleventh-pass official and first-party verification for six existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. The pass adds current regulated-entity, company, exact-venue and exact-site planning evidence without creating a second task or runner and without advancing operation 291, promoting an exact parcel or publishing parcel values.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction pages, first-party operator pages, NHS service records, Companies House, Charity Commission and local-authority planning records are promoted. A current operator, regulated entity or planning record does not prove legal completion, executed lease terms or exact title geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
